threshold_note: threshold is rolling (window per lookback); threshold_value is the latest rolling value — see winner_trade_log.csv for the full threshold path
strategy_description: Long SPY when the lagged New Home Sales signal is above its threshold; otherwise short SPY. (Countercyclical orientation: weak/decelerating home sales = risk-on.)
lead_description: Signal lead = 13 month(s); L1 is the real-time floor given the ~4th-Tuesday Census publication lag for the prior month
notes: Mode 2, nhs_spy. Tournament: 14300 strategy combos (+1 benchmark, valid=False per ECON-T4), 9971 valid. Winner by ECON-T3 cascade (resolved at step 1; 1 tied at step 1). Strategy returns are gross of transaction costs; 5 bps sensitivity in tournament_validation_20261008/. NHS is NSA (FRED HSN1FNSA); signals are YoY/STL-deseasonalised, raw level excluded. Lead-lag: Toda-Yamamoto Granger NHS->SPY significant at lags [11]; SPY->NHS significant at lags [1, 2, 3]. Robustness caveats: winner bootstrap p = 0.069 (vs resampled B&H); in-sample Sharpe 0.67 vs OOS 1.54; CP1 durability verdict 'conditionally_durable'; rolling-correlation stability 'moderately_stable'. OOS mean position 0.72.

selection.objective_formula: argmax OOS Sharpe over valid combos, ECON-T3 cascade tie-break (oos_sharpe -> oos_ann_return -> min|DD| -> n_trades -> signal)
selection.rationale: Winner is the max-OOS-Sharpe valid combo (9971 valid of 14300); cascade resolved at step 1 with 1 tied at step 1.
